blocks.html: Summit Hotel Magnolia: An inviting respite for business travelers

An inviting respite stands in the quieter side of one of the busiest business district of Quezon City--the Summit Hotel Magnolia. A place to rest yet conducive to work as well, Summit Hotel Magnolia is designed as an urban jungle getaway for business travelers, super chic and uber cool with great amenities, charm and personable service. Our friendly and knowledgeable corporate sales staff can help coordinate all your business needs – from a Super suite catering to the discerning business traveler, to an event space for hosting your business training, workshops, and meetings, big or small.

Whether you are attending a business function in Cubao Quezon City, Pasig Ortigas or San Juan area, Summit Hotel Magnolia is an ideal choice for business travelers. Located along Doña Hemady Street corner Aurora Boulevard, New Manila, Quezon City, Summit Hotel Magnolia is situated in the former Magnolia Ice Cream House’s place where the Robinsons Magnolia mall now stands and is accessible via public transport and metro railway system with LRT 2 Gilmore station just a block away.

The third hotel property under the Summit Hotels collection, this unique boutique hotel showcases functional design starting from its elegant lobby, common areas to its stylish rooms and themed suites. Each room is wonderfully spacious, designed to be relaxing and outfitted with stylish interiors, luxe furniture and vibrant artworks.

The experience of good service does not end inside the hotel given the wide array of restaurants and recreational facilities located right at your doorstep as Summit Hotel Magnolia has direct access to Robinsons Magnolia mall.

"2015 is already shaping up to be a really great year for Summit Hotel Magnolia" says Hotel Manager Pops del Rosario. "With the range of innovative room promotions and selection of guest perks in collaboration with the hotel's brand partners, we expect to keep this momentum going throughout the rest of the year."
Whether you want to refresh your mind from work, reminisce the old times, dine with good food, and more, Summit Hotel Magnolia has it all for you.
Following are the reasons to book a room now:
Stay connected and Stay Productive

Summit Hotel Magnolia makes business travel easy. In addition to being located within close driving distance from major business districts, the hotel provides a wide range of room amenities for a productive business trip. As a business traveler, you can choose from any one of our 82 rooms and suites, each with plenty of space to spread out and work. From the moment you check in, our hotel offers everything you will need including complimentary WIFI with dedicated router in each room, well appointed working desk with comfortable executive chair and easily accessible power outlets at desk level. A 24-hour work station located in the hotel’s lobby is also available.

All rooms at Summit Hotel Magnolia are modern and spacious with room sizes ranging from 32sqm to as large as 42sqm. Enjoy a peaceful night’s sleep at our Super rooms – available as a Twin, King and Family! Super Twin rooms can accommodate two adults and two kids, Super King rooms can accommodate two adults and two kids as well, and Super Family rooms can accommodate three adults and two kids.

Our Super King rooms are equipped with Super King beds - two twin-sized beds (42 inches wide each) placed side-by side to make a total width of 84 inches or 8 inches wider than a regular king bed. At the end of a busy day, roll around in the glorious comfort of high quality bed linens, non allergenic pillows, duvet covers and a super soft pillow top mattress pad that add a cloudlike surface to the beds. Staying in Summit Hotel Magnolia is like being on a flight and upgraded to business class seating, giving one substantial legroom in bed, as well as, superior room amenities.

All Super rooms are equipped with large bathrooms with hot and cold super shower, premium bath toiletries, hair dryer and vanity mirror. All rooms feature an RFID (Radio Frequency Identification), proximity card and lock system; and comes with essential amenities such as complimentary bottled water, complimentary coffee/tea making facility, a mini-bar chiller, in-room safe, and a 42-inch flat screen TV equipped with HDMI, USB ports, and premium cable channels. Pressing iron and ironing board are available upon request.

Wake up refreshed to a hot and hearty Conti’s Breakfast. Conti’s is a growing chain of bakeshops and full service restaurants known for their delicious and innovative cakes, pastries and take-out commissary items. Hotel guests will enjoy Conti’s extensive plated breakfast menu choices consisting of: Homemade Beef Tapa, Mom’s Garlic Longganisa, Daing na Bangus, Chicken Arroz Caldo, American breakfast, among others.

Breakfast is served with Conti’s freshly baked breads such as cheese/raisin/cinnamon swirls, mamonitos and dinner rolls and a choice of free flowing coffee, tea or lemonade. Breakfast service is promptly available from 7:00am until 10:00am daily.

For business travelers looking for their morning coffee fix, Starbucks is located just a few steps away where guests can enjoy their fresh cup of hand crafted Starbuck coffee with views of Robinsons Magnolia alfresco garden as part of a relaxing stay in this boutique hotel.
Themed suites for a unique stay experience

Extending your stay or planning your next business trip? Ask about our themed Super Suites. Experience your way through all of the four (4) themed suites that feel more like the fully furnished condominium that you wished you lived in, than a hotel room. Packed full of beautifully designed features with careful attention to detail, each suite offers an intimate, personalized and comfortable stay. These themed rooms can invoke nostalgia, or perfect for couples who want a honeymoon stay, or for group of friends who want to throw an intimate party.

First on the list is the Magical Suite, which is inspired by Moorish architecture. The suite is adorned with flamboyant tracery, curved arches and Moroccan filigree lamps. Perfect for a throwback, another suite is aptly named the Nostalgic Suite, which is a modern homage to the historic Magnolia factory. Third is a glamorous Hollywood-themed suite dubbed as the Fabulous Suite, which is adorned with movie posters, luggage side tables, and a bathtub with a peek-a-boo view to the bedroom. Last is the Asian-inspired Divine Suite that offers a zen-like space to guests.
Extra Comforts and Conveniences

Housed within the Robinsons Magnolia complex, with direct access to the mall area from 11:00am to 9:00pm daily, Summit Hotel Magnolia is perfect for business travelers looking to maximize their time in the city.

After a busy day at work, come home to Summit Hotel Magnolia and choose from a wide array of dining facilities and cuisines all conveniently located in Robinsons Magnolia. Guests can choose from indoor or al fresco type of dining from the list of restaurants including Conti's, Lombardi, Uncle Cheffy, Gumbo, Starbucks, UCC, Sumosam, Ramen Nagi, Akira, Cibo, Arya, Elias, and Buffet 101.

You can also squeeze in some well-deserved retail therapy at the same award-winning mall where guests has easy access to the international brands such as H&amp;M, Uniqlo, Topshop/Topman, Mango, Dorothy Perkins, Muji, Warehouse, Anne Klein, Fred Perry, Lacoste, Penguin, Ecco, Nine West, Promod, Gap, Cotton On, Aeropostale, Springfield, Cache Cache, Superga, Giordano and Steve Madden among many others.

And to cap a busy day, call the front desk to book for yourself a relaxing massage or mani-pedi right in the comfort of your very own room. Lunula Nail Salon and Day Spa provides hotel guests with massage therapists and nail technicians available on call from 11:00am to 9:00pm daily.

Lunula Nail Salon and Day Spa combines products that are carefully chosen with wide range of massage techniques to pamper and restore balance to both body and mind. They offer Swedish, Shiatsu, Traditional Hilot and Ventosa massages.
Below are the benefits of the different type of massages:
• Swedish light to medium-pressured strokes to relax and alleviate muscular tension; effectively increasing circulation, removing metabolic waste while encouraging a feeling of connectedness.
• Shiatsu light to medium-pressured strokes to relax and alleviate muscular tension; effectively increasing circulation, removing metabolic waste while encouraging a feeling of connectedness.

• Traditional Hilot The Filipino’s ancient way of healing, Hilot, is very good for detecting imbalances early on, and is very effective at bringing the body back to its proper balance. The firm, definite strokes of Hilot can help relax and even ward off and prevent certain sickness from getting worse. Our therapists also use dagdagay sticks, two (2) bamboo or rattan sticks, in place of finger pressure on the legs and foot to stimulate the soles and cleanse and purify the soles of the feet.

• Ventosa The heat and the suction applied through Ventosa therapy is able to unblock the Meridian within the body. Meridians are channels where an individual’s Chi travels around in. A single blockage in the flow of Chi results in bodily disorders eventually felt by the person. Ailments connected may include asthma, rheumatism, back pain, and insomnia. Clearing the blockage is designed to cure and prevent these disorders. Ventosa therapy is ideal for anyone who wishes to experience traditional Asian medicine in its purest form.

Guests may also opt to have a foot spa – an intensive treatment using technically advanced hard skin removal techniques, combining deeply nourishing products to repair, replenish and condition nails or have their nails done by trained nail technicians who are updated with the latest trends in nail art and nail products.
Enjoy big discounts and more business traveler perks

At Summit Hotel Magnolia, business travelers are treated to complimentary lifestyle magazines upon check-in and a FREE Robinsons Privilege Card that gives cardholders instant shopping and dining discounts at any Robinsons mall. This summer, guests will be entitled to a series of special dining vouchers from partner restaurants all found inside Robinsons Magnolia mall.

And for a limited time offer, Summit Hotel Magnolia offers special room rate discount promos for up to 40% until August 2015 for holders of Robinsons Privilege Card, Robinsons Rewards Card and BDO card. Promo rates apply to all room types, and include plated breakfast for two. Terms and conditions apply.

Planning your next business trip? You can count on Summit Hotel Magnolia to provide ideal accommodations and corporate sales packages to suit all types of business needs. Book now! Contact us at 397-1888 local 150, 164, 165, and 169 or visit us on the web at www.summithotels.ph.
